order_handling.name: Order Handling
order_handling.driver_description: Number of order lines (each line requires processing)
order_handling.rationale_size: Share of Modeled CTS; calibrated so total CTS ≈ 10% of Net Sales.

distribution.name: Distribution
distribution.driver_description: Observed freight value charged (proxy for logistics effort — not internal cost)
distribution.rationale_size: Largest pool share. Billed freight is a proxy, not platform logistics cost.

warehousing.name: Warehousing
warehousing.rationale_size: Physical-weight proxy; marketplace sellers often fulfill.

returns_waste.name: Returns / Non-Fulfillment
returns_waste.activity: Non-fulfillment handling (canceled/unavailable proxy — not true physical returns)
returns_waste.driver_description: Canceled / unavailable lines as non-fulfillment proxy
returns_waste.rationale_size: Small share; allocation to zero-revenue months is mechanical.

note: Pool sizes from config.py; reconciliations verify allocated + unallocated = pool.
